column1: # A JEWISH WOMAN BORN LEIBHOLZ WHO SURVIVED AND DIED IN 1982 — AND WHOSE FORENAME IS WITHHELD.
# Landesarchiv Berlin, P Rep. 480 Nr. 1240, Namensverzeichnis zum Sterberegister,
# Standesamt Spandau, 1982, page 100 of 207. Read through pdf.js 21 September 2026.
# *** WHY A DEAD WOMAN'S FORENAME IS NOT PRINTED HERE. ***
# Her forename, set beside the surname she was born with, IS ALSO THE MAIDEN NAME OF A LIVING
# PERSON IN THIS FAMILY. Publishing the pair would put a living woman's former name on a public
# site, which this archive does not do, whoever it is actually about. The two are certainly
# different people — one died in 1982 — but a search engine does not know that and neither does
# a reader. THE FORENAME IS HELD IN THE PRIVATE NOTES AND IS DAVID'S TO RELEASE. Everything else
# is here, including the register number, so the certificate is orderable without it.
field
# ---------------- THE ENTRY, IN ITS OWN COLUMNS ----------------
*** WHAT THE LINE SAYS ***
column2: Leibholz verh. Schönfeld | [forename withheld] | 19. 5. | 1486 | mos. | verw. Six columns: BIRTH SURNAME LEIBHOLZ · MARRIED SURNAME SCHÖNFELD · forename · died 19 MAY 1982 · Sterberegister Spandau 1982 NR. 1486 · religion MOSAISCH · status VERWITWET, widowed.

column1: *** AND "MOS." IS THE WORD THAT MATTERS ***
column2: MOSAISCH — Jewish. A JEWISH WOMAN BORN LEIBHOLZ, ALIVE IN BERLIN-SPANDAU AND DYING THERE IN 1982. This archive's Berlin story has been, until now, a story of deportation and of survivors who left. She did neither.

column1: how the convention was established rather than assumed
column2: the same page carries "Lehner verh. Knappe Rosina", "Leibner verh. Podgurgki Klara Hedwig Margarete" and "Leichsenring verh. Weißer Elise Marie". THE HEAD-WORD IS THE BIRTH NAME AND "verh." INTRODUCES THE MARRIED NAME, consistently, three times on one page. So she was BORN a Leibholz and MARRIED a Schönfeld, and is not a woman who married into the name.

column1: # ---------------- WHY SHE WAS NOT WHO WAS BEING LOOKED FOR ----------------
the sweep was for ERNA
column2: Erna Leipholz of Streitstraße 39 is in the Berlin telephone book to 1980-81, so her death is after 1981 and inside the thirty-year window. Spandau 1982 was opened for her. SHE IS NOT IN IT.

column1: # ---------------- AND TWO THINGS THIS ARCHIVE ALREADY HELD, NEITHER FOLLOWED ----------------
*** YAD VASHEM GIVES SAMUEL LEIBHOLZ A WIFE WITH THE SAME FORENAME ***
column2: Yad Vashem 5415605, SAMUEL ISRAEL LEIBHOLZ born 1877 at Schubin — Jacob's brother — is recorded as married, with a wife whose forename is the one withheld above. data/yadvashem-leibholz.tsv marks it "<- NEW. This archive had no wife for Samuel." IT WAS RECORDED AND NEVER FOLLOWED.

column1: *** AND THE AROLSEN TRACING FILES CONTAIN A LEIBHOLZ FILE INDEXED UNDER SCHÖNFELD ***
column2: data/arolsen-tracing-files.tsv, in the enumeration of forty-three topics: "one 6.3.3.1 microfilm correspondence file (INDEXED UNDER SCHÖNFELD)". A Leibholz tracing enquiry filed under the surname Schönfeld. THE SAME MARRIED SURNAME AS THE 1982 ENTRY.

column1: *** BUT THE TWO WOMEN ARE PROBABLY NOT ONE, AND THE INDEX CONVENTION SAYS SO ***
column2: if she were SAMUEL'S WIDOW she would have been born something else and married INTO Leibholz, and this index would list her under her own birth name as "Xxx verh. Leibholz". IT LISTS HER AS "LEIBHOLZ VERH. SCHÖNFELD", which makes Leibholz the name she was born with. *** SO THE LIKELIER READING IS A LEIBHOLZ DAUGHTER AND NOT SAMUEL'S WIFE. ***

column1: what would decide it
column2: the death entry itself, Spandau 1982 Nr. 1486, which carries her birth date, birthplace, address and informant. A purchase, and not mine. THE FREE TEST FIRST: the Berlin marriage indexes for a LEIBHOLZ–SCHÖNFELD marriage, which would name her father and settle whose daughter she is at no cost.

column1: NOT KIN ON ANY EVIDENCE HELD
column2: no document joins her to Jacob, Samuel or Oskar of Schubin. What she is: a Jewish woman born Leibholz, in Berlin, who outlived the war by thirty-seven years.

column1: # ---------------- THE NEGATIVE THAT CAME WITH HER ----------------
Spandau deaths 1982
column2: P Rep. 480 Nr. 1240, 207 pages, the Le- block bracketed Leidl · LEIPNITZ · Leipold. NO LEIPHOLZ AND NO ERNA. The one Leibholz on the page is this woman.
